description: Complete contraindication and therapy blocking rules extracted from all three engine schemas. Preserves all clinical safety behavior exactly as authored.

absoluteContraindications.name: PREGNANCY_ABSOLUTE_LOCK
absoluteContraindications.clinicalRationale: HEALTHY-9 is PREGNANCY ONLY — single kit, no other kits during pregnancy. Period.

absoluteContraindications.name: PREGNANCY_TOPICAL_BLOCK
absoluteContraindications.output: Doctor consultation required — no standard topical safe in pregnancy
absoluteContraindications.clinicalRationale: All Minoxidil, Finasteride, Dutasteride, and anti-androgen topicals are contraindicated — systemic absorption risk to foetus.

contraindicatedWhen.trigger: is_pregnant === true OR planning_pregnancy === true OR hormonal_issues includes 'pregnancy'

contraindicatedWhen.note: Systemic absorption causes BP fluctuation — Minoxidil vasodilator effect compounds hypertension medication
Alcohol vehicle strips epidermal barrier, exacerbates immune-mediated psoriatic flares
Alcohol vehicle worsens scalp dryness, dandruff, and inflammation
Both Minoxidil and Finasteride contraindicated in pregnancy
Minoxidil systemic absorption causes BP fluctuation
Spironolactone and Minoxidil both contraindicated in pregnancy
Contains Dutasteride 0.5% (5-alpha reductase inhibitor) — teratogenic, absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy and conception planning

preferredVariantRule.description: F-Emugrow MCR (without Dutasteride) preferred over MCRD for females under 30
preferredVariantRule.clinicalRationale: Dutasteride (D) not indicated for females under 30 — follicle not yet miniaturised enough; MCR provides Redensyl/peptide support without the 5-alpha reductase blockade
preferredVariantRule.sourceCodeReference: topical-engine.schema.json decisionTree[FEMALE_PSORIASIS, FEMALE_DANDRUFF_ITCHING, FEMALE_DRY_OR_INFLAMED] — F-Emugrow MCR for age < 30

contraindicatedWhen.note: Anti-androgen topical — contraindicated in pregnancy and conception planning

restrictedTo.note: PCOS facial hair add-on only — not for general hair fall
Female hormonal thinning only — not for general hair fall or male patients

contraindicatedWhen.note: Oral Minoxidil 1.25mg may be used if BP is controlled — doctor decision. Systemic vasodilation compounds antihypertensive medication.

ageRestriction.note: Mandatory cardiac evaluation required before prescribing oral Minoxidil for patients over 60 — increased systemic vasodilation risk, orthostatic hypotension

finasterideRestrictions.name: FINASTERIDE_PREGNANCY_BLOCK
finasterideRestrictions.clinicalRationale: Finasteride (5-alpha reductase inhibitor) is teratogenic — causes feminisation of male foetus. Absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy.

finasterideRestrictions.name: FINASTERIDE_MALE_UNDER_18_BLOCK
finasterideRestrictions.output: Avoid Finasteride entirely — cautious Minoxidil only under specialist supervision
finasterideRestrictions.clinicalRationale: Finasteride not indicated for males under 18 — androgenic axis not fully developed; potential for irreversible hormonal effects.

kitForbiddenCombinations.name: PCOS_INGREDIENT_OVERLAP_FORBIDDEN
kitForbiddenCombinations.rule: NEVER prescribe both in the same protocol

triggers.resolution: Use PRO FACT META B PCOS only — drop F-PCOS -1
Upgrade F-PCOS -1 to PRO FACT META B PCOS at runtime (DT_011)

kitForbiddenCombinations.clinicalRationale: Duplication of Inositol/D-Chiro/Spearmint/NAC/Chromium/Zinc creates ingredient over-dose risk.

kitForbiddenCombinations.name: META_B_HYPOTHYROID_FORBIDDEN_WITH_META_B
kitForbiddenCombinations.rule: NEVER prescribe both in the same protocol
kitForbiddenCombinations.trigger: THYROID_HYPO + obesity/sedentary → swap to PRO FACT META B (DT_009); drops META B HYPOTHYROID
kitForbiddenCombinations.clinicalRationale: PRO FACT META B is a superset of PRO FACT META B HYPOTHYROID covering the dual metabolic+thyroid axis — co-prescribing creates redundant dosing.

kitForbiddenCombinations.name: META_B_PCOS_FORBIDDEN_WITH_META_B_HYPOTHYROID
kitForbiddenCombinations.rule: NEVER prescribe both in the same protocol
kitForbiddenCombinations.trigger: PCOS_OBESITY + Hypothyroid → merge to single PRO FACT META B (DT_010)
kitForbiddenCombinations.resolution: Remove PRO FACT META B PCOS and PRO FACT META B HYPOTHYROID; insert PRO FACT META B at position 0
kitForbiddenCombinations.clinicalRationale: Overlapping AMPK/insulin correction pathways. Single PRO FACT META B covers all three axes: androgen suppression, insulin correction, and T3 metabolic support.

kitForbiddenCombinations.name: WEIGHT_LOSS_SHIELD_FULL_TE_GOLD_FORBIDDEN
kitForbiddenCombinations.source: clinical-engine.schema.json → protocolSequencer[WEIGHT_LOSS].rationale; therapySignals[RAPID WEIGHT LOSS SHIELD]
kitForbiddenCombinations.rule: When RAPID WEIGHT LOSS SHIELD is in Phase 1, TE GOLD must be used in REDUCED SCOPE only
kitForbiddenCombinations.reducedScopeInstruction: TE GOLD in REDUCED SCOPE — iron/ferritin repletion + residual stress-TE explanation only. Exclude Iron/B12/Zinc/Biotin/Selenium/Amino explanation (already covered by Shield).
kitForbiddenCombinations.clinicalRationale: Full ingredient overlap between RAPID WEIGHT LOSS SHIELD and standard TE GOLD scope — co-dosing creates over-supplementation risk for micronutrients with narrow therapeutic windows (especially iron and selenium).

suppressionRules.name: TE_GOLD_SUPPRESSION_REGROW_GOAL
suppressionRules.compensation: Inject PRO IMMUNE GOLD if not already present
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: TE GOLD stops active shedding. If shedding has already stopped (regrow goal), TE GOLD has no clinical purpose and adds unnecessary cost.
suppressionRules.hiddenRule: HR_004: This suppression applies even to protocols that normally include TE GOLD (THYROID_HYPO, PERI_MENOPAUSE, THYROID_HYPER). Hormonal protocols detected under regrow path are still routed, but TE GOLD is stripped from them.

suppressionRules.name: TE_GOLD_SUPPRESSION_THINNING_ONLY
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: v39 rule: No active shedding (thinning only = miniaturisation pattern) → TE GOLD mechanism targets active shedding cascade. Miniaturisation requires DHT-blockade and follicle activation, not cortisol/mTOR/ferritin correction.
suppressionRules.sourceCodeReference: getFunnelKits lines 4012-4019; questionnaire count step STEPS[5]

suppressionRules.name: TE_GOLD_SUPPRESSION_RULE_1A
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Triple-condition: AGA female + PCOS + rapid weight loss. Shield covers the GLP-1/crash-diet precipitating event; PCOS kit corrects androgen axis; FPHL corrects pattern loss. TE GOLD ingredient overlaps with Shield.

suppressionRules.name: FPHL_AGE_GATE_UNDER_30
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Female under 30 with AGA signals: follicle miniaturisation has not progressed enough for FPHL kit to be effective. TE GOLD + PRO IMMUNE GOLD for shedding arrest and follicle activation instead.

suppressionRules.name: HBR_KIT_SIGNAL_GATE
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Heat/chemical treatment damages the hair shaft but does not by itself cause the specific type of breakage HBR targets. Hard water in cause is the required clinical corroboration. (Q3 'Broken/short' hairtype option retired — no longer a valid corroborating signal.)

suppressionRules.name: HBR_KIT_PROTOCOL_CAP_REMOVAL
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: HBR is a lower clinical priority than core condition kits. When protocol complexity exceeds 5 kits, HBR is removed to avoid over-prescription.

suppressionRules.name: OXIDATIVE_STRESS_TWO_SIGNAL_THRESHOLD
suppressionRules.rule: OXIDATIVE STRESS kit injected as standalone phase ONLY when oxidativeCount >= 2 AND PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION not already in protocol. Single smoking/vaping selection → PHENOTYPE only.
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Single oxidative signal is adequately addressed by PHENOTYPE INFLAMATION (NF-kB/TNF-alpha suppression + glutathione restoration). Two+ signals indicate systemic mitochondrial ROS load requiring dedicated OXIDATIVE STRESS kit (Astaxanthin 6000x singlet oxygen quenching + CoQ10 + ALA).

suppressionRules.name: PRO_FACT_GI_GOLD_STRONG_SIGNAL_GATE
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Mild bloating alone does not indicate the intestinal dysbiosis requiring L-Glutamine mucosal repair or Digestive Enzyme supplementation. Strong signals (IBS/GERD/Crohn/Constipation) confirm structural gut-hair axis compromise requiring GI GOLD intervention.
suppressionRules.sourceCodeReference: clinical-engine.schema.json therapySignals[PRO FACT GI GOLD] trigger note

suppressionRules.name: EARLY_GREY_AGE_GATE
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Early/premature greying is a condition of younger patients. At 30+, greying is within normal physiological range and the clinical protocol differs — greying co-condition still injectable via S._hasGreyGoal if reported, but the dedicated EARLY_GREY absolute lock is not available.

suppressionRules.name: GRADE_QUESTION_AA_SKIP
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Alopecia Areata is an autoimmune condition, not a graded pattern loss. Grade scoring is irrelevant and potentially misleading for AA. The AA protocol (score 105, near-absolute) bypasses grade-based routing.

suppressionRules.name: HEALTHY9_SINGLE_KIT_ENFORCEMENT
suppressionRules.clinicalRationale: Any non-pregnancy kit during pregnancy introduces ingredients with unknown foetal risk profiles. HEALTHY-9 is specifically formulated for pregnancy nutritional support.

hormoneRestrictions.name: HORMONAL_QUESTION_FEMALE_ONLY
hormoneRestrictions.clinicalRationale: Hormonal conditions (PCOS, menopause, endometriosis, pregnancy) are female-only clinical pathways. Male patients route directly to gut question.

hormoneRestrictions.name: THYROID_OPTION_RUNTIME_REMOVED_FROM_HORMONAL
hormoneRestrictions.reason: Thyroid is captured in the dedicated thyroid/metabolic question (STEPS[11]). Inclusion in hormonal would create duplicate scoring.
hormoneRestrictions.crossFieldNote: Downstream code checks BOTH thyroid field AND hormonal field for 'Thyroid' — the cross-dependency still functions correctly via thyroid step, even with this option removed.

hormoneRestrictions.name: FPHL_MPHL_KIT_GENDER_LOCK
hormoneRestrictions.clinicalRationale: MPHL and FPHL have different active compounds targeting male vs female androgen pathways. Cross-gender prescription would be clinically inappropriate.
hormoneRestrictions.sourceCodeReference: resolveKit() lines 3420-3438; dynamicTransitions DT_002 and DT_003

ageGates.name: AGA_ABSOLUTE_LOCK_AGE_THRESHOLD
ageGates.clinicalRationale: Grade 4/5 pattern loss at age 20+ is definitively androgenetic — weighted scoring cannot improve on this diagnosis. Absolute lock prevents scoring noise from co-conditions from routing away from the correct AGA protocol.

ageGates.name: FPHL_UNDER_30_PROTOCOL_OVERRIDE
ageGates.clinicalRationale: Female under 30 with genetics-driven AGA signals: follicle miniaturisation not yet progressed enough for the 5-alpha reductase blockade and dermal papilla compounds in FPHL to be effective. TE GOLD + PRO IMMUNE for shedding arrest and anagen re-entry.

ageGates.name: ORAL_MINOXIDIL_OVER_60_CARDIAC_CAUTION
ageGates.clinicalNote: Mandatory cardiac evaluation required before prescribing oral Minoxidil for patients over 60

ageGates.name: MALE_UNDER_18_FINASTERIDE_ABSOLUTE_BLOCK

gradeModifier.grade123: Mild non-hormonal topicals: F-Emugrow MCRD / Trichogain
gradeModifier.grade45: Strict doctor supervision required — cautious Minoxidil only

ageGates.clinicalRationale: Androgenic axis not fully developed in males under 18. Finasteride-mediated 5-alpha reductase inhibition can cause irreversible hormonal effects during development.

ageGates.name: EARLY_GREY_OPTION_AGE_CUTOFF
ageGates.clinicalRationale: Greying at 30+ is within physiological range — not classified as premature. EARLY_GREY absolute lock protocol is not clinically indicated.

hypertensionRules.name: HYPERTENSION_TOPICAL_EARLY_RETURN

trigger.structuralGap: NO structured checkbox triggers this — detection depends entirely on free-text fields. Known gap: TC_04.

caution: Oral Minoxidil 1.25mg (only if BP is controlled — doctor decision)
hypertensionRules.contraindictionNote: Minoxidil is contraindicated due to systemic vasodilation — oral absorption compounds antihypertensive medication effects and can cause dangerous BP fluctuation.
hypertensionRules.clinicalRisk: TC_04 — hypertension detected via free text only: a structured intake that never mentions 'hypertension' or 'blood pressure' in free text fields will SILENTLY MISS this contraindication, allowing Minoxidil prescription to a hypertensive patient.

pcosException.note: PCOS protocols use dedicated cap of 7 kits (vs standard 4-5) — allows PCOS+Obesity+FPHL+Inflammation+Immune+HBR co-prescription when clinical signals support it

hiddenSafetyRules.name: PCOS_PRIORITY_BOOST_THYROID_DOMINANCE
hiddenSafetyRules.detail: PCOS score raised from 92 to 101 — makes PCOS dominant over THYROID_HYPO at 100
hiddenSafetyRules.clinicalRisk: If thyroid is the TRUE primary driver and PCOS is mild/co-incidental, the system still routes to PCOS protocol. Thyroid may be under-treated.

hiddenSafetyRules.name: THYROID_CROSS_FIELD_DETECTION
hiddenSafetyRules.clinicalNote: THYROID_HYPO score is triggered by EITHER thyroid field OR hormonal field 'Thyroid' option — cross-field dependency. The hormonal 'Thyroid' option is removed at runtime by IIFE (HR_003) but the cross-check still functions via the thyroid step.

hiddenSafetyRules.name: ACTIVE_SHEDDING_PROTOCOL_OVERRIDE

trigger.conditions: NOT isRegrowGoal AND NOT hasNoVisibleFall AND (dominantKey starts with 'TE_' OR count includes 50/100/Noticeable OR duration 1-3/3-6 months OR cause includes Stress/Nutritional/Medication/Illness/Surgery)

hiddenSafetyRules.clinicalRisk: Fires AFTER protocol sequencer lookup — silently overrides the clinically-intended Phase 1 kit. For AGA_MALE_45 and THYROID_HYPER protocols where PRO IMMUNE GOLD is intended as Phase 1, active shedding will displace it to position 1.

hiddenSafetyRules.name: PCOS_STACK_HANDLED_FLAG_STATE_RISK
hiddenSafetyRules.clinicalRisk: This flag is set on global state object S. If getFunnelKits() is called multiple times without resetting S, the flag persists and incorrectly blocks PRO IMMUNE for non-PCOS subsequent calls.

hiddenSafetyRules.name: GLP1_DOUBLE_ENFORCEMENT_RACE_CONDITION
hiddenSafetyRules.detail: GLP-1 early shield positioning re-enforced at lines 3895-3901 AND again at lines 3991-3998 after liftPhase reordering. If liftPhase is modified to include RAPID WEIGHT LOSS SHIELD, the double-enforcement creates unexpected ordering.

hiddenSafetyRules.name: HYPERTENSION_DETECTION_FREE_TEXT_ONLY
hiddenSafetyRules.detail: Hypertension contraindication gate checks ansText for 'hypertension' / 'blood pressure'. Neither word appears as a structured checkbox option in any questionnaire step. The gate can ONLY fire if the patient mentions it in free-text (extra, medical_detail).
hiddenSafetyRules.clinicalRisk: A patient with hypertension who does not use these exact words in free text will receive standard Minoxidil recommendation — a dangerous prescription for a hypertensive patient.
hiddenSafetyRules.recommendedFix: Add hasHypertension: boolean to PatientAnswers, wire it to a structured chronic conditions checkbox in Q4 (medical step)
